name: movie-qp-floor-16
description: Movie: lower the H.264 encoder's minimum QP from 20 to 16. There are two set-ups: the first frame (0x7EEA57D4, `mov 20,d0` at 0x7EEA5A1F, block-0 offset 0xA84A00) and every later frame (0x7EEA5C4C, `mov 20,d0` at 0x7EEA5EBB, offset 0xA84E9C). Both write the codec register 0x994043A8 as max<<8|min. The stock encoder holds QP at 20 while using only ~41% of its 20.48 Mb/s budget (experiments/2026-11-12-hardware/04-mov-clip-analysis.md, 05-qp-floor.md). The bitrate target, HRD buffer and 24 Mb/s parameter check are unchanged. Movie-only; restore = stock v1.6.
